**Explore the future of the graphic design world with our 2026 Trend Report.**

​​In 2026, design is showing its hands again. Think lace and silverware pulled into zine layouts, travel ephemera taped into digital pages, stitches, paper grain, candy wrappers, glassy blur, and soft serif titles that feel like a paused film frame. Everywhere you look, designers are leaning into texture, collage, ornament, and quirk as a quiet rebellion against uniformity and artificial perfection.

Across branding, packaging, social, and editorial, visuals are slowing down just enough to let us all absorb a point of view. What does it mean to be obviously humanmade? Thoughtfully authored? This year, creative industries are leaning hard into some of the undeniable marks of human inspiration: texture, individualism, asymmetry, and spontaneity.

Rococo Romance leans into vintage objects, delicate lace, embossed textures, jewelry details, and sculptural accents. Pair that with romantic line art, medieval leaning letterforms, ornate frames, and editorial mockups, and you get a visual language that says maximalism, but in a zine maker’s hands. Think embossed papers, lace edging, silverware still lifes, and collage elements that feel pulled from art history folders, then recomposed into poster like layouts.

Tactile texture and collage emerge as an antidote to algorithmic sameness. Expect this to show up in fragrance and beauty packaging, boutique hospitality branding, wedding adjacent stationery, and cultural posters where decoration becomes the message.

### "After years of minimalist everything, we're seeing a return to richness and detail. Layered textures, bold color combinations, ornamental details that actually mean something."

— Jeremy from [H&C Drawings & Designs](https://creativemarket.com/HCDesignStudio)

Peak Journal is the art of the collected page. Receipts, labels, tickets, stamps, envelopes, tape bits, ruled sheets, and scribbled notes all shape a distinct look that carries diary layout energy. This trend features a mix of stamp graphics, café handwriting, postcard grids, and Canva templates built for travel storytelling, and you get layouts that feel like someone actually went somewhere.

Accents include paper fragments and pages, notes and documents, travel ephemera, envelopes and stamps, tape details, lace, and quotes, ready for collage and journaling workflows. This trend thrives in social templates, creator brands, newsletters, and packaging that reflects each of our unique, inner journeys.

Peak Journal celebrates freeform storytelling and the warmth of everyone’s personal visual styles.

### ¨Design isn’t heading toward more perfection - it’s heading toward more personality. The future belongs to work that feels made, not produced: characters over faceless neutrality, human quirks over algorithmic symmetry."

Slowly Knit is a craft revival aesthetic built from lace patterns, cross stitch references, woven textures, floral clipart, and storybook print ephemera. Tactile design and slow, visible craft will dominate in 2026, especially as a counterweight to AI smoothness. Expect to see this nod to gentle arts in home goods, specialty food packaging, small batch branding, and editorial inserts that want to celebrate a slower, more human rhythm.

Director’s Cut is typography and layout that feels like a film title sequence paused at the best frame. Soft serifs with human irregularity, cover style crops, imperfect grain, and intimate composition. Think title cards, cinematic stills, and creator stories where the design supports personal, intimate storytelling. This trend connects strongly with the broader 2026 push toward emotional connection as a core brand skill.

We expect to see more serif families built for editorial cadence, hand drawn serif shapes with personality, and layout kits that mimic print pacing and grainy looks for digital screens. Director’s Cut is especially fitting for book covers, documentaries, album artwork, creator led brands, and campaign landing pages that want mood without relying on stocky assets.

Hand-drawn Revival is linework that looks like it came from someone’s sketchbook, not a vector plugin. Designers are leaning into irregularity, texture, and authored imperfections as a way to signal humanity. Expect more mascot systems, hand drawn icon sets, and illustrated packaging that feels personal and imperfect by design.

# 30 Brilliant Canva Templates and Graphics

### Contents

[![](https://d3ui957tjb5bqd.cloudfront.net/uploads/2025/04/16083626/V1.png.webp)](https://creativemarket.com/membership?utm_medium=blog)

Creative Market Last updated: April 17, 2024 · 6 min read

- [![Facebook](https://d3ui957tjb5bqd.cloudfront.net/uploads/2021/02/01124100/fb-icon.svg?fmt=webp)](https://www.facebook.com/sharer/sharer.php?u=https%3A%2F%2Fcreativemarket.com%2Fblog%2Fcanva-templates-graphics)
- [![Twitter](https://d3ui957tjb5bqd.cloudfront.net/uploads/2021/02/01124101/twt-icon.svg?fmt=webp)](https://twitter.com/intent/tweet?text=30%20Brilliant%20Canva%20Templates%20and%20Graphics&url=https%3A%2F%2Fcreativemarket.com%2Fblog%2Fcanva-templates-graphics&via=creativemarket)
- [![Shorten Link](https://d3ui957tjb5bqd.cloudfront.net/uploads/2021/02/01124101/link-icon.svg?fmt=webp)](https://creativemarket.com/blog/canva-templates-graphics#)

![Pinterest](https://d3ui957tjb5bqd.cloudfront.net/uploads/2018/06/17024317/49771.pinterest-260x353.jpg.webp)

Is Canva part of your toolkit? If you’re in love with the power and flexibility of this free online design platform, you’ll want to take a look at these professionally-made [Canva templates](https://creativemarket.com/templates/canva).

## 1\. DIY Canva Logo Pack

[DIY Canva Logo Pack](https://creativemarket.com/connectedcolleague/2542542-DIY-Canva-Logo-Pack) offers 180 editable elements for making your own logo. Fifteen pre-made logos can jump-start your creative process. Designer Tasha DaCosta specializes in empowering small businesses.

## 2\. Instagram Overlays – Social Media

[Instagram Overlays](https://creativemarket.com/carrahtompkins/1636993-Instagram-Overlays-Social-Media) depict water themes with a grunge aesthetic. Created by Brand Blitz Company, they’re perfect for entrepreneurs looking for minimal design themes. Package includes 8 transparent PNGs for Canva.

## 3\. Minimal Blog & Social Pack

Elena Sanchez at Graphica Studio specializes in sleekness. Her [Minimal Blog & Social Pack](https://creativemarket.com/graphicastudio/1480107-Minimal-Blog-Social-Pack) is geared toward fashion and lifestyle bloggers, and offers a template package [customized for Canva](https://creativemarket.com/graphicastudio/1663542-CANVA-Minimal-Social-Media-Pack?u=graphicastudio&utm_source=Link&utm_medium=CM+Social+Share&utm_campaign=Product+Social+Share&utm_content=CANVA+Minimal+Social+Media+Pack+%7E+Social+Media+Templates+on+Creative+Market).

## Brush Strokes and Splatters Bold

Do [Brush Strokes and Splatters Bold](https://creativemarket.com/Creative_Stash/2000452-Brush-strokes-and-splatters-bold) express the spirit of your event or website? Creative Stash has you covered, with a set of 65 different freewheeling overlays.

## 5\. Marble-Theme Instagram Template

What could be more elegant than marble as the background for that perfect quote? Carey-Lee Dixon of 1104 Creative offers 5 customizable [Marble-Theme Instagram Quote Templates](https://creativemarket.com/1104Creative/2554556-Marble-Theme-Instagram-Template).

## 6\. Baker Boss PNG Scene Creator

The only thing better than eating frosting is decorating with it! [Baker Boss PNG Scene Creator](https://creativemarket.com/Cosmicreations/2410902-Baker-Boss-PNG-Scene-Creator), from MyCosmicShop, gives you photos of baked goods and ingredients to assemble unlimited deliciousness.

## 7\. Plants & Growth Social Media Pack

Looking to go green on Canva? Illumineer Media & Design provides high-quality images in their [Plants & Growth Social Media Pack](https://creativemarket.com/IllumineerYollie/1514463-PLANTS-GROWTH-Social-Media-Pack). Show the world that your brand is environmentally woke!

## 8\. Rose Gold Tech Mockups + Scene Creator

A Canva scene creator for “girl bosses,” by Girl Boss Stock. Use these [Rose Gold Tech Mockups](https://creativemarket.com/girlbossstock/2508063-RoseGold-Tech-MockupsScene-Creator) with or without shadow, to depict the devices that drive your day.

## 9\. Modern Subtle Floral Patterns Bundle

Step into Lara’s Wonderland and experience her delicate artistry. The [Modern Subtle Floral Patterns Bundle](https://creativemarket.com/laramai/2026163-Modern-Subtle-Floral-Patterns-Bundle) is a veritable garden of 500 softly drawn botanical elements.

## 10\. Instagram Design Set – Mint Ice Cream

It’s summer, and that means it’s time to cool off with a [Mint Ice Cream Design Set](https://creativemarket.com/ebobrysheva/1775230-Instagram-design-set-Mint-Icecream). Bye Boss’s 11 frames and backgrounds in soft greens are ready to use on your smartphone app.

## 11\. Vintage Floral Frames

[Vintage Floral Frames](https://creativemarket.com/pixelperfectlibrary/1488443-Vintage-Floral-Frames) create a dreamy, romantic setting. The 12 lovely frames by Pixel Perfect Library come in four color options for inspirational brand creation.

## 12\. Mockup Creator + Templates for Canva

[Kate Danielle Creative](https://creativemarket.com/kate.danielle) gives you everything you need to get your business off the ground. Their Mockup Creator and Templates for Canva offer 35 customizable design elements and a link to a free Canva course.

## 13\. Rose Gold Social Media Templates

Minimal, romantic, and luxe: of course we’re talking about [Rose Gold Social Media Templates](https://creativemarket.com/essemcreatives/1434585-Rose-Gold-Social-Media-Templates). Artist Sneha Mohanty offers her watercolor paintings in a beautifully coordinated set of Canva images.

## 14\. Canva Instagram Hand-Drawn Stories

These [hand drawn stories for Instagram](https://creativemarket.com/SilverStag/2594595-CANVA-Instagram-Hand-Drawn-Stories) gives you access to a unique collection of social posts and animated stories for Canva all in one spot. Designer SilverStag offers a free newsletter with even more discounts.

## 15\. Canva Fresh Insta Stories

Twelve ready-made [Canva Fresh Insta Stories](https://creativemarket.com/goldenwhimsystudio/2380485-CANVA-Fresh-Insta-Stories) will get your message online in moments. Golden Whimsy Studio includes bonus photos and fonts that you can easily customize and make your own.

## 16\. Tropical Summer Instagram for Canva

Ready for some bright blue water and inflatable flamingos? Designer Alysha DeMarsh at Basil and Bark is offering the perfect summer templates with [Tropical Summer Instagram for Canva](https://creativemarket.com/basilandbark/2545661-Tropical-Summer-Instagram-for-Canva).

## 17\. Instagram Templates for Canva

Perfect for looking inward, [Instagram Spiritual Templates for Canva](https://creativemarket.com/MyScarlettDesigns/2388302-Instagram-Templates-edit-in-Canva) suggest a meditative calm for your yoga studio or self-awareness blog. My Scarlett Designs makes it simple to express your true self.

## 18\. Journey Collection: Canva Templates

Get in the mood for vacation with the [Journey Collection – Canva Templates](https://creativemarket.com/taurewen/2461469-JOURNEY-Collection-Canva-Templates). [Babski Dizajn’s](https://creativemarket.com/taurewen) image choices will lead viewers to some of the earth’s most beautiful spots.

## 19\. Facebook Group Canva Templates: Eva

With [Facebook Group Canva Templates – Eva](https://creativemarket.com/NicholetteStyles/2407845-Facebook-Group-Canva-Templates-Eva), designer Nicholette Von Reiche provides bonuses galore. Get your group started with cover graphics, prompts, announcements, and a video tutorial!

## 20\. Manifestation Webinar Canva Template

Make it happen with [Manifestation Webinar Canva Template](https://creativemarket.com/coralantlercreative/2606155-Manifestation-Webinar-CANVA-Template). This 9-page template from Coral Antler Creative comes with instructions to help you deliver a flawless presentation.

## 21\. Lead Magnet Bundle for Canva

Attract new customers with this cool customized workbook. Basil & Bark‘s [Lead Magnet Bundle for Canva](https://creativemarket.com/basilandbark/2490910-Lead-Magnet-Bundle-for-Canva) makes it quick to produce an irresistible freebie or premium gift.

## 22\. Pinterest-optimized Templates

Another innovation from Alysha DeMarsh, the [Pinterest Optimized Templates for Canva](https://creativemarket.com/basilandbark/2438022-Pinterest-Optimized-Templates-CANVA) will make you a social media “influencer.” Now your Pinterest page will boast professional design.

## 23\. Canva Real Estate Banners

If you’re in real estate, you’re always looking for something to make you stand out. Aviva Darab offers a gorgeous 12-pack of [Canva Real Estate Banners](https://creativemarket.com/aviva.darab/2090016-CANVA-Real-Estate-Banners), certain to attract new clients’ eyes.

## 24\. Email Templates for Canva

Email marketing is essential for your business, but it’s hard to think up ways to make your messaging “pop.” Jessica Gingrich has a glossy solution for you, with her [Email Templates for Canva](https://creativemarket.com/jessgingrich/2311721-Email-Templates-for-Canva).

## 25\. Mompreneur Planner

Do you know someone who needs the [Mompreneur Planner](https://creativemarket.com/VanessaRyan/2124765-Momprenuer-Planner-Canva-Indesign)? Could that person be you? With VanessaRyanCo’s beautiful planner pages, you can organize your own life or help others.

## 26\. Canva Golden Social Media Pack

Bring a golden touch to your Canva designs with the [Golden Social Media Pack](https://creativemarket.com/MarigoldStudios/1746359-CANVA-Golden-Social-Media-Pack). With more than 100 templates, as well as free images, fonts, and gold texture from Marigold Studios, you can’t lose.

## 27\. Canva Social Media Templates

[Bluchic](https://creativemarket.com/bluchic) is all about feminine themes, and their bundle of [85 Canva Social Media Templates](https://creativemarket.com/bluchic/1308910-CANVA-Social-Media-Templates) will hand you a bouquet of choices. For Instagram, Facebook and Twitter, each template includes 5 design variations.

## 28\. Pinterest Canva Bundle

Drive traffic to your Pinterest page with the [Pinterest Canva Bundle](https://creativemarket.com/StationSeven/2476648-Pinterest-Canva-Bundle). Thirty unique templates from the husband-and-wife team at Station Seven include free fonts and plenty of helpful advice.

## 29\. Social Media Bundle Canva

Do you need a smooth, professional template to highlight your photographs? From Distinct Darlings, the [Social Media Bundle for Canva](https://creativemarket.com/distinct.darlings/2574021-Social-Media-Bundle-Canva) fits the bill with templates, file links, fonts, and a tutorial.

## 30\. Blog Branding Kit: Canva Templates

Use Canva to customize your brand; C.C. Creative makes it simple with the [Blog Branding Kit](https://creativemarket.com/connectedcolleague/2490555-Blog-Branding-Kit-Canva-Templates). Website headers, sidebar buttons, graphics, and feature images are all included.

Dozens of artists offer customizable Canva graphics through Creative Market. Check out the rich variety of their designs today!

# ‘Imperfect by Design’: The visual design trends set to define 2026

December 11, 2025

> Our 2026 Design Trends reveal 2026 is the Year of Imperfect by Design, a creative rebellion where imagination rules, curiosity expands, and creators bend AI to their own style, sparking a more human era of visual expression.

* * *

TL;DR:

- 2026 marks the rise of a new creative standard: ‘Imperfect by Design’, where many creators will become unbothered by perfection, polish, or creating for the algorithm, and instead embrace the human imperfections that make work personal, raw, and honest.

- Our forecast inspired by millions of creators, billions of Canva designs, and insights from celebrated designers shows that visual authenticity has become the new creative paradox, with ten major trends – from tactile textures to cinematic storytelling – helping creators bend AI to their own instincts and create with impact.

- Canva’s 2026 Design Trends toolkit makes these looks accessible to any professional or everyday creator to discover, experiment, and bring ideas to life.


Every year, creativity takes on a new shape, molded by the world around us, the technology that inspires us, and what we’re collectively needing right now. As we head into 2026, we analyzed search trends from our community of more than 260 million people, alongside insights from our [Designer Advisory Board⁠(opens in a new tab or window)](https://www.canva.com/newsroom/news/designer-advisory-board/) and a global survey of 1,000 creators, to uncover the cultural shifts and habits influencing how we create and communicate today. Together, these perspectives revealed 10 design styles that are set to take over our visual worlds (and feeds) in the year ahead.

Across all ten trends, one theme stood out: creators are embracing AI to express themselves visually, while craving the human imperfections that make design raw, honest, and unique.

They’re letting go of the pressure to polish every single detail and returning to something far more powerful: imagination. Although AI is becoming a seamless creative tool to bring ideas to life faster, the real magic happens when it’s paired with curiosity and courage to imagine the impossible. And creators are gearing up for this moment: 80% said 2026 is the year we regain creative control.

But this isn’t a retreat or move away from technology. AI remains a central part of creators’ workflows, with 77% describing it as an “essential partner”. This moment is about using AI on our terms, and making the imperfect feel real and powerful again, even if it’s messy or inconsistent.

From sensory textures to cinematic storytelling, 2026 is the Year of Imperfect by Design, a reminder that great ideas rarely start perfect, but they always begin imagined.

Here are the 10 design trends set to define how you create in the new year.

## Reality Warp

Today, when people create online, that first step off a blank page often starts with AI. But creators are also taking it a step further by leaning into what they see as the look and feel of the synthetic era.

That brings us to our first trend, [Reality Warp⁠(opens in a new tab or window)](https://www.canva.com/design-trends/?trendId=reality-warp), which invites creators to dive head first into today’s AI-generated world by intentionally blurring the lines between the real and the surreal. Blending editorial energy with surreal digital elements like dreamy compositions, otherworldly vibes, and distorted filters to produce visuals that feel uncanny but undeniably cool, it’s a playful reminder that the future looks weird and wonderful.

And many creators agree, with searches for “liminal” and “uncanny” aesthetics up 220% year over year, drawing more than 2 million views, and almost a quarter of creators we surveyed saying they predict Reality Warp will be the defining trend of 2026.

## Prompt Playground

Our next trend, [Prompt Playground⁠(opens in a new tab or window)](https://www.canva.com/design-trends/?trendId=prompt-playground), is where tech empowerment and our inner child start to play together. One of the biggest drivers for this trend is the rise of vibe coding as people increasingly design for emotional impact first and foremost.

Visually, we’re seeing UI elements that aren’t usually seen as interesting, like spreadsheets, dropdowns or bits of code, becoming a new creative playground for how we experiment and express ourselves. It’s nostalgia for early computing aesthetics mixed with AI experimentation.

Interest in this aesthetic is growing on Canva, with lo-fi and retro-tech styles up 48.9%, including a 527% spike in “lo-fi aesthetic” and a 201% rise in “data visualization animation” generating more than 60,000 searches. It’s no surprise that 14% of creators surveyed predict Prompt Playground will be one of 2026’s defining trends.

## Explorecore

As people look for calm in an overstimulated digital world, [Explorecore⁠(opens in a new tab or window)](https://www.canva.com/design-trends/?trendId=explorecore) shows an increasing desire to break free from the endless doomscroll and give our minds permission to breathe, wonder and discover new things. We’re seeing this show up throughout our global design community, with “Zine” and “Substack” aesthetics up 85% year over year, drawing more than 78 million impressions.

With beautifully simple layouts, interactive elements, and clean serif fonts, it’s perfect for anyone who wants their content – whether a presentation, video or social post – to create calm instead of clutter, and have their viewers slow down and explore at their own pace.

## Texture Check

Our next trend, [Texture Check⁠(opens in a new tab or window)](https://www.canva.com/design-trends/?trendId=texture-check), comes from a huge boom in tactile design, driven by everything from the rise of CGI tools to Apple’s shift from smooth UI to Liquid Glass. We’ve also seen Canva searches for textures like “soft neutral backgrounds” and “tactile design” grow 30% year over year, reaching nearly 16 million impressions, highlighting a shift not just towards how something looks, but also how it feels.

Visually, this trend is surface-first. Think designs that look super glassy, translucent, waxy, and hyper-realistic, almost like physical materials, elevating even mundane textures to something special. Textures so real you want to reach out and touch them.

## Notes App Chic

[Notes App Chic⁠(opens in a new tab or window)](https://www.canva.com/design-trends/?trendId=notes-app-chic) is the deep exhale we all need right now. It celebrates the messiness of everyday life and a growing need to create for fun instead of the algorithm. It looks like someone opened their camera roll, notes folder, and scrapbook at the same time, and let it all merge together in the most charming way. From lo-fi, behind-the-scenes Reels to hand-cut collage elements, it celebrates unfinished thoughts, rough ideas, and happy accidents — the stuff we usually choose to hide.

The shift toward unpolished visuals is tied to a cultural push for progress over polish. Searches for DIY and scrapbook-style elements are up 90% year over year, generating more than 1 million impressions on Canva as creators continue to lean into designs that feel authentic, relatable, and real.

## Opt-Out Era

As a nice follow-on from Notes App Chic, [Opt-Out Era⁠(opens in a new tab or window)](https://www.canva.com/design-trends/?trendId=opt-out-era) stems from taking a visual timeout from digital burnout and the constant hustle, and feeding a desire to express ourselves (26%), connect with others (25%) and a nostalgia for simpler times (24%) according to our new creator survey.

We’re seeing serif fonts, paired back palettes, straightforward logos and structured editorial layouts replacing bright visuals and bubbly fonts. “Anti-cuteness” is on the rise with mascots and playful graphics being toned down or even replaced with more grounded visuals. For example, Canva searches for “clean layout,” “serif,” and “simple branding” have climbed 54% year over year, generating over 45 million impressions.

Opt-Out Era all about embracing the subtle art of doing less.

## Drama Club

Our research shows creators are turning to high-drama visuals, especially when it comes to social media content (46%), art or illustrations (41%), videos (35%), and even decks (33%). [Drama Club⁠(opens in a new tab or window)](https://www.canva.com/design-trends/?trendId=drama-club) stems from a universal craving to escape today’s realities and feel more connected, no matter where you are in the world.

We'll see more and more creators lean into Hollywood glam, cinematic stills, parody or soap opera style clips, and bold typography that makes everyday moments feel rich, moody, and unapologetically dramatic.

Creators are increasingly turning to meta-storytelling, with searches for things like“mockumentary,” “dramatic spotlight,” and “stage curtain background” up 27% year over year, drawing more than 1.7 million impressions across our platform.

## GrannyWave

As part of our visual forecasting, we also explored what’s trending locally across key markets like India, Mexico and Spain, where we found design is returning to its roots.

In India, we’re seeing comfort of nostalgia powering an exciting revival of heritage with a modern lens, with loud, layered, and full-of-heart visual storytelling.

We’re seeing everything from the return of regional crafts and handloom patterns to hyper-saturated, festival-inspired colour palettes and even a touch of Bollywood-era glamour, which shows that maximalism isn’t just a trend – it’s the next natural step in the country’s design evolution.

We’re calling the trend [GrannyWave⁠(opens in a new tab or window)](https://www.canva.com/design-trends/?trendId=grannywave) and it’s something we’re seeing become more popular across our community as well, with searches for Indian-inspired elements like “Desi” and “Hindi Typography” up 26% and 17% year over year, generating more than 280,000 impressions.

## Zinegiest

Over in Mexico, [Zinegeist⁠(opens in a new tab or window)](https://www.canva.com/design-trends/?trendId=zinegeist) brings back the ‘zine’ look and makes it louder than ever, whether it’s anti-gloss paper, cut-and-paste layouts, messy collages, or bold, oversized type. It’s creative, expressive, and wonderfully imperfect, encouraging people to embrace a DIY spirit in how they design.

Zinegeist is resonating as local creators look for more handmade, expressive alternatives to overly digital aesthetics. Searches related to bold type and DIY layouts – including “brutalist design,” “bold typography,” and “type poster” – rose 77% year over year, generating nearly 14 million impressions right across our community.

## Block Party

For our final trend, [Block Party⁠(opens in a new tab or window)](https://www.canva.com/design-trends/?trendId=block-party), we can expect local creators from Spain to interweave rich cultural symbols, vintage hues, and everyday pastimes, reimagined with bold color and modern flair. The final product is warm, nostalgic, and full of charm; a trend anyone can use to add emotional storytelling and personality to their visuals.

We’re also seeing a love for Spanish-inspired styles like “Estética Tradicional” and “Folklore Urbano” build, with 1.5 million impressions this year, reflecting a strong desire to bring cultural roots into modern design.

## Make the trends your own

No matter how often you create, whether it’s daily or in those magic moments when inspiration sparks, our 2026 Design Trends toolkit is here to help you explore what’s possible. Discover on-trend motion and static templates, illustrations, and visual inspiration that give you the confidence to imagine, experiment, and make something you’re proud of this new year.

[Start exploring the 2026 Design Trends now⁠(opens in a new tab or window)](https://www.canva.com/link?target=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.canva.com%2Fdesign-trends%2F&design=DAW5TiBqbsY&accessRole=owner&linkSource=comment)

# Canva Templates to Share 2026 Goals on Social Media

Filed in [Content Marketing](https://hautestock.co/category/content-marketing/), [Featured](https://hautestock.co/category/featured/), [Social Media](https://hautestock.co/category/social-media/), [Templates](https://hautestock.co/category/templates/) — January 6, 2026

Share Post

## Share Your New Year Intentions, Goals & Vision with Your Audience

If you’re mapping out your 2026 content and looking for stylish ways to share your goals, intentions, or mindset shifts, these new and exclusive to Haute Stock _Intentions_ and _Momentum_ Canva Template Packs were designed for you.

Perfect for coaches, creatives, content creators, and wellness brands, these templates make it easy to turn your personal growth and business vision into powerful, on-brand content that builds connection and authority, without starting from scratch.

Let’s explore how to use these intention-setting templates to kick off the year with meaning, momentum, and magnetic content.

![](<Base64-Image-Removed>)

### What’s in the Intentions & Momentum Canva Template Packs

These two new Haute Stock Canva template collections are the perfect pairing for New Year energy.

The **Intentions Templates** include visuals for:

- Word of the Year
- Monthly mantra or theme
- Energy reset routines
- Personal reflections and rituals
- “Things I’m loving lately” roundups

![](<Base64-Image-Removed>)

## How to Use These Templates for Your Brand

#### **Word of the Year Graphics**

- Choose from elegant layouts to reveal your 2026 word of the year, plus templates to share _why_ you chose it.
- Use it in a **carousel post** that walks your audience through your thought process, values, and how it aligns with your offers or life.
- Prompt your followers to share theirs in the comments to get instant engagement!

#### **Mindset & Energy Reset Templates**

- Designed for sharing your routines, rituals, or new ways you’re choosing to show up this year.
- Try a **“before and after” vibe** in your captions to show how you’re shifting habits (and how that ties into your work or client experience).

#### **Goal-Setting & Monthly Focus Pages**

- Editable pages that feel like mini digital vision boards or planning boards.
- Perfect for **monthly check-ins** with your audience — share what you’re working on, invite them to reflect alongside you.
- Reels idea: use a voiceover to narrate your goals while showing the template visuals on screen.

![](<Base64-Image-Removed>)

The **Momentum Templates** are designed for:

- Monthly goals and daily check-ins
- Productivity and mindset shifts
- Lists, planners and habit trackers
- Journal-style affirmations and quotes
- Gentle reminders to rest and reset

![](<Base64-Image-Removed>)

## How to Use These Templates for Your Brand

#### J **ournal Prompts & Affirmation Cards**

- These add depth and personality to your content. Let your audience _see your mindset_ behind the strategy.
- Use them as **Story slides** with a “tap to reveal” format or create a weekly “Mindset Monday” carousel series.

#### **30-Day Planner & Daily Check-In Pages**

- Show your structure in action. Great for talking about time-blocking, boundaries, or how you stay grounded while building.
- Use these to **educate and inspire** your audience. You can even turn them into email graphics or standalone IG posts to build authority.

#### **Personal Notes & Reflections**

- These “handwritten” style quote templates make your posts feel intimate and authentic.
- Use for as storytelling openers for deeper captions.

Both packs feature calm, minimal layouts with space for personal photos, hand-written style fonts, and thoughtful design details — aligned with the _Wellness_, _Editorial_, and _Feminine_ brand aesthetics.

## Why These Templates Work for Brands

You’re not just posting for the algorithm, you’re building trust, sharing your journey, and positioning yourself as a thoughtful, intentional brand.

These templates:

- Save you hours of design work each month
- Help you show up _consistently_ and _professionally_
- Guide your audience from follower to fan by sharing _why_ you do what you do
- Let you create content that’s visually stunning _and_ emotionally resonant

Instead of staring at a blank screen wondering what to post, you’ll have a toolkit of ready-to-use graphics that connect and convert. [**Find them all inside the Haute Stock Membership**](http://www.hautestock.co/membership)!

## Key Takeaways

- These Canva templates help you create high-impact, intentional content for January and beyond
- Designed for wellness leaders, coaches, creatives, and mindful entrepreneurs
- Ideal for sharing goals, words of the year, mindset shifts, and monthly reflections
- Pairs perfectly with Haute Stock’s _Reset_, _Wellness_, and _Soft CEO_ collections
- Can be used on Instagram, Stories, email, blogs, and digital offers

## Ready to Set Intentions with Style?

Start creating beautiful, meaningful content with the **Intentions** and **Momentum** Canva Template Packs, available exclusively for Haute Stock members. **[Become a member and get instant access](http://www.hautestock.co/membership)**.
